sql.query: SELECT COUNT(*) players, SUM(completed), SUM(meets_requirements), SUM(continuity_missing), SUM(title_dup), SUM(choice_dup), SUM(desc_dup), SUM(generic_titles), SUM(attr_zero_offered), SUM(attr_not_applied), SUM(rank_residual), SUM(illegal_rank_change), SUM(llm_errors) FROM players WHERE combo_id=27
